Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game and this series as well. Moeen Ali has been handed the trophy and the England players are posing for some team pictures. England will now continue with their travel and go straight to Australia and play the home side in a three-game T20I series leading up to the T20 World Cup. The first match will be played on 9th October at 1.40 pm IST (8.10 am GMT). On the other hand, Pakistan will move to New Zealand to take part in a T20I tri-series which will involve Bangladesh as well. Their first match will be against Bangladesh which will be played on 7th October at 7.30 am IST (2 am GMT). Do join us for the coverage. Till then, take care and goodbye.

Moeen Ali, the skipper of England is up for a chat. He says that it was a very good series and credits his bowlers for the way they performed throughout the series. Adds that all the batters played really well too even though they failed a few times to chase down the total. Mentions that when they needed two must-win games the boys stepped up and it was amazing to see that. Ends by thanking the crowd and PCB for hosting England.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan is up for a chat. He says that it was difficult to chase 200 runs after losing early wickets. Further says that their plan didn't work from the start of the match. Says they will sit and talk about what went wrong. Tells that Haris Rauf has been positive for them. Says they are missing Shaheen Afridi and hopes to have him back soon.

Harry Brook is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES. He says that the plan is to hit the ball straight. Adds that he had a lot of practice sessions in the nets and says that he tries to hit the ball straight but when there is an opportunity he looks to manipulate the field. Mentions that all the players are looking forward to the T20 World Cup but first they need to get out and get to Australia. Ends by saying that it has been good fun to be in Pakistan.

Dawid Malan is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that they treated this game as a final and it was a fantastic effort from them. Further says that the ball was coming on the bat nicely till the 12th over but after that, it started slowing up. Adds that they will leave for Australia and hopes that they perform well.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the game, Babar Azam won the toss and put England into bat. The English batters looked aggressive and even when they lost a couple of wickets early, everyone just kept on attacking. Dawid Malan played a brilliant inning from one end which ensured that the visitors finished on a score of above 200. The Pakistani bowlers, apart from Haris Rauf, didn't pose much threat and Mohammad Wasim had a game to forget. With a mammoth total to chase down, the Pakistani openers faltered and from then on it was all England.

Pakistan have been heavily reliant on Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan in this series and with both of them getting out very early in the innings, life was made very difficult for them. The only shining light was Shan Masood who once again showed his class by playing a lone hand. But with plenty needed, their middle order just didn't have enough in them to get even close to the English target and they will be disappointed to lose the series in such a way in front of a packed home crowd.

England had a big score on the board and all they needed was early wickets and they got just that. The English pacers made short work of the Pakistani top order in the Powerplay and set up the game nicely. The spinners too were able to control the game in the middle phase and in the end, they won the game quite comfortably.
What a fabulous series we've had and it is England who clinched the 7-game series 4-3 and they have done so in some style. Pakistan were completely outplayed in the decider.

A couple of runs to end! This is on a hard length and around off, Mohammad Hasnain slices it in the air towards deep extra cover for a couple of runs. That is it for this game and the series. ENGLAND WIN BY 67 RUNS AND TAKE THE SERIES 4-3.
Another short delivery, on off, Mohammad Hasnain swings at it but misses.
Short of a length and on off, Haris Rauf tries for the pull shot but toe ends it towards point for a single.
WIDE! This is on a length but way outside off. Wided.
In the air..safe! This is short of a length and on off, Mohammad Hasnain miscues his pull shot high in the air, but it lands safely between mid off and mid on. A single is taken.
This is full and on off, Mohammad Hasnain drils it towards deep extra cover for a brace.
Mohammad Hasnain is the next man in.
OUT! TIMBER! David Willey strikes now. He bowls this on a good length and on middle, Mohammad Hasnain moves across to scoop it but misses and the ball goes through to rattle the stumps.
Haris Rauf walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! A brilliant catch from Rashid and Masood has to go back now. Woakes bowls this on a hard length and around off, Shan Masood slashes at it but gets thick outside edge towards short third man where Adil Rashid dives forwards to take a stunning catch. Chris Woakes gets his third wicket and Pakistan lose their seventh.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice placement! This is a low full toss and outside off, Shan Masood throws his bat at it and slices it through backward point for a boundary.
A good slower one now, full and around off, Shan Masood is way early into his slog and cannot connect.
Short of a length and on down the leg side, Mohammad Wasim goes for the hook shot but gloves it towards fine leg for a single.
Full toss, around leg. Mohammad Wasim misses to flick that through fine leg but misses. It goes off the pads to the keeper.
Short, around off. Shan Masood pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Chris Woakes (3-0-20-2) is back on.
Slower and fuller, onto the pads. Mohammad Wasim looks to play it towards fine leg but misses to connect.
FOUR! Sam Curran bowls it full, around off. Mohammad Wasim drills it down the ground past the bowler for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! Sam Curran gets rid of Mohammad Nawaz now. He bowls this short and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz tries to go for the pull shot towards the deep square leg region but picks out Chris Woakes there who makes no mistake. This is the longer side of the ground and that is why he fails to clear the fence. Pakistan lose their sixth.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Woakes b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Full, onto the pads. Shan Masood knocks it to deep square leg for a run.

Shout for a caught behind, not given and it's referred! Sam Curran goes full and down the leg side. Shan Masood looks to flick but misses, the keeper has collected it well above the ground. They appeal but the umpire signals nothing and the England skipper decides to refer. It's a legal ball and the UltraEdge confirms nothing on it and it is been signalled a wide.

FIFTY FOR MASOOD! This has been another good innings from him and he gets his second half-century of th series. This is short, outside off. Shan Masood pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Sam Curran strays down the leg. Shan Masood looks to flick that but misses.
FOUR! Sam Curran bowls it short, outside off. Shan Masood crunches it over extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot but it does not matter now. This is full and on middle and leg, Mohammad Nawaz stays there and drives it hard down the ground towards the wide long on fence for a boundary.
A low full toss, on off, Shan Masood drills it to the right of point where the fielder dives to that side and stops it well. Only a single.
Topley pull his length back a bit, on middle, Mohammad Nawaz pulls it through mid-wicket for one more.
WIDE! Reece Topley loses his line a bit and bowls this way outside off, Mohammad Nawaz is too far away to play at it. Wided.
Topley goes for the yorker again but serves this full and around off, Shan Masood squeezes it towards deep point for a run.
Short of a length and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A yorker and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz is late to put his bat down and misses.
Willey bangs this short and on middle, Shan Masood pulls it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
A slower one, on a length and outside off, Shan Masood slices it over point where Dawid Malan backs away, chases and puts in a dive to keep it in. Two runs taken!
Short of a length and on off, Mohammad Nawaz tries for the pull shot but toe-ends it to the off side. They cross.
Swing and a miss! David Willey bowls this touch fuller and on off, keep low too, Mohammad Nawaz goes for the big slog but misses as the ball goes under his bat towards the keeper.
Slower ball, outside off. Shan Masood swings it hard towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slower delivery, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz knocks it to deep cover for a run. 100 up!

OUT! TAKEN! Chris Woakes gets his second wicket and sends Asif Ali back to the hut. He bowls a slower one, short and on middle, Asif Ali tries to go for the pull shot but hits it from the toe end of his bat. As a result, he fails to generate the power and it goes in the air towards deep square leg where Reece Topley takes a good catch. Pakistan lose half of their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Reece Topley b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller delivery, outside off. Shan Masood drives it towards the cover fielder for a quick single.
Fuller and slower. Asif Ali mistimes his shot toward long off for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Asif Ali. Chris Woakes bowls a full toss delivery, onto the pads. Asif Ali dispatches it for a boundary towards the fine leg region.
Slower ball, outside off. Shan Masood knocks it to covers for a run.
Chris Woakes ( 2-0-12-1) is back on.
Fuller in length, on the leg stump. Masood swings wildly and gets a thick inside edge towards the deep square leg region for a run.
Full, outside off. Asif Ali plays it to long off for a run.
LEG BYES! Short of a length, Sam Curran follows the batter. Shan Masood looks to pull but misses and hits his pads and they run a leg bye.
Short, outside off. Asif Ali plays it to covers for a run.
Short, around off. Shan Masood pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
WIDE! Sam Curran misses his line and strays it down the leg side.
Length delivery, on the leg stump. Masood misses out on the pull.
Slower through the air, on off, Asif Ali guides it towards short third man. End of a successful over for England.

Another brilliant googly, full and on middle, turning in sharply, Asif Ali misses attempted block and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge shout for LBW but turned down. It was probably turning a bit too much to the leg side.
RIPPER! This is flighted, full and on middle, turning away sharply, Asif Ali looks to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A googly now, on middle, turning in, Asif Ali blocks it out.
Asif Ali is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Adil Rashid gets a wicket now and Pakistan lose their fourth. He bowls this quicker, short and on leg, Khushdil Shah looks to flick it away but gets a thin edge towards the keeper where Philip Salt moves to his left and completes the catch. There is an appeal for the catch and up goes the finger. Khushdil Shah decides to go for the review but UltraEdge shows a spike and he has to make the long walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: A bit of indecison from the umpire but he raises his finger for the caught-behind appeal and Khushdil Shah reviews it. The UltraEdge shows that indeed there is bat involved and Shah has to walk back.

SIX! BOOM! That is more like it from Shah! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Khushdil Shah stays there and slogs it over the deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The 50-run partnership comes up with that.
Adil Rashid to bowl out here.
FOUR! A streaky one but Shan Masood won't mind. This is on a hard length and around off, Shan Masood swings hard for the heave but gets an outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Topley nails the yorker this time, outside off, Khushdil Shah digs it out to the off side and gets across for a run.
Full again and on leg, Shan Masood goes for the slog but misses and the ball deflects off his pads to the off side. A leg bye is taken.
Goes fuller this time and on middle, Khushdil Shah uses his feet and drills it towards long off for a run.
Short of a length and on leg, Shan Masood makes room and slaps it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Reece Topley comes back into the attack and bowls this back of a length and on middle, Khushdil Shah pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on the stumps. Shah flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length, on off. Khushdil Shah knocks it to mid on but the bowler stops it.
Fuller length, on off. Khushdil Shah pushes it back towards the bowler.
Short, around middle. Shan Masood sweeps it deep square leg for a run.
Slower through the air, around leg. Shan Masood hits it back towards the bowler and Adil Rashid stops the ball with his boot.
Short, around off. Khushdil Shah knocks it to long off for a run.

Drinks break! England are right on top at the halfway mark in the chase. They have picked up early wickets and now it is about game management. The inconsistent Pakistani middle-order has a big job on their hands and for now, Shan Masood and Khushdil Shah are showing positive signs. Still, with 142 runs needed off 60 balls, they will need to pull off a miracle here.
Full and quick on the legs. Shan Masood does well to clip it towards deep mid-wicket and adds pressure on the fielder as they come back for the second.
Length ball, a cutter around middle and off. Shah knocks it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Sam Curran bowls leg cutter, around middle and leg. Khushdil Shah comes down the pitch and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Short, around off. Shan Masood knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slower short ball, outside off. Khushdil Shah pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slower ball, around off. Khushdil Shah plays it to short third man.
Sam Curran has been handed the ball now.
Flighted, full and on middle, Shan Masood sweeps it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs. 13 runs from the over!
Short and on leg, Shan Masood flicks it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a brace. Good running!
SIX! BANG! Shan Masood clears the fence! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Shan Masood stays there and slogs it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and on middle, Khushdil Shah works it towards mid-wicket for a run.

A tough stumping chance! This is flatter, full and on leg, follows the batter well, here, Shan Masood skips down the track and looks to flick it away but misses and the ball goes between his legs just kissing the pads through to the keeper where Philip Salt parries it with his pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Looped up, full and on middle, Khushdil Shah reverse-sweeps it towards deep point for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Khushdil Shah knocks it towards covers for a single.
A bit short, on middle, keeps low, Khushdil Shah pushes it to the left of the bowler where Moeen Ali gets across and dives to stop it.
Floated, full and on middle, Shan Masood uses his feet and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and on the leg stump line, Khushdil Shah tickles it towards short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Khushdil Shah pats it back to the bowler.
Moeen Ali starts with a short delivery, on leg, Khushdil Shah tucks it with soft hands towards deep square leg for a brace.
Moeen Ali is into the attack now.
Lofted ball, on off. Khushdil Shah knocks it to long off for a run.
Floated up, full on off stump. Masood punches it down to deep cover for a single.
Short, onto the pads. Shan Masood pulls it but mistimes it and the ball stays on the pitch.
Short, outside off. Khushdil Shah cuts it to deep point for a run.
Full, on off. Shan Masood knocks it to long on for a run.
Short, onto the pads. Shan Masood flicks it to short fine leg for a run.
Full, around off. Shan Masood knocks it to mid off and they scramble a quick single but there's a direct hit towards the non-striker's end. Shan Masood is home though.

Is that a run-out? The players appeal but then don't seem interested. Still, the umpire plays it safe and has gone upstairs! Sam Curran scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the replays show that Shan Masood is a long way in. NOT OUT!
Short, around off. Khushdil Shah nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Full, onto leg. Shan Masood knocks it to mid on for a run.
Short, outside off. Khushdil Shah plays it with soft hands to covers and they run a single.
Short, outside off. Khushdil Shah knocks it to the fielder at point.
Khushdil Shah is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Simple chance for the wicket-keeper and Philip Salt makes no mistake. David Willey comes from over the wicket and serves a short ball, on off and angling across. The pace is taken off the delivery and Iftikhar Ahmed backs away trying to cut it behind square. The ball takes a faint tickle and goes into the keeper's mitts. Pakistan in a big spot of bother here.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a length and on the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Great shot! Reece Topley serves this full and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed stays there and drives it firmly wide of mid off for another boundary.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but Pakistan will take it. This is short and around leg, Iftikhar Ahmed goes for the pull shot but hits it more from the bottom half towards the deep square leg fence where Reece Topley dives to his right, but cannot stop it from going for a boundary.

Risky single! This is full and on off, Shan Masood drives it towards cover and sets off for the single, Sam Curran there picks up and has a shy at the batter's end but misses and Ahmed is safe. A direct hit and he would have been gone.
Length again, on middle and leg, Shan Masood nudges it towards mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed dabs it towards point and gets across for a quick single.
Reece Topley comes from the other end now.
Full and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed drills it towards mid off for a run.

DROPPED! Another dropped catch in this game and this time it is England. David Willey bowls this back of a length and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge straight up in the air. David Willey calls for it, settles under it to his right, adjacent to the pitch but spills it. Philip Salt, the keeper, should have gone for this catch but the opportunity is gone now.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, keeps a bit low, Iftikhar Ahmed plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Willey bowls this back of a length and on leg, Shan Masood jabs it towards short fine leg for a run.

Golden chance! Every bad situation is an opportunity to get stronger and better. The middle order of Pakistan has been absent in this series so far, and with two mainstays of their batting dismissed cheaply, it's a fantastic opportunity for the batters to stand up and prove their mettle under scorboard pressure. This series was considered as a perfect way to prepare for the mega event, and Pakistan will get a shot in the arm if their middle order ends up doing something unimaginable tonight.
This is on a hard length and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed guides it uppishly towards point for another run.
David Willey starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Shan Masood pushes it towards mid off for a run.
David Willey comes on to bowl now.
This is full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed knocks it towards short mid-wicket.
This is on a length and on middle, slower too, Shan Masood works it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful timing! Chris Woakes bowls this on a good length and around off, Shan Masood stays there and just guides it through backwards point for a boundary.
A slower one now, full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed tucks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder gets a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batter is safe.
Full again and on leg, angling in, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to play at it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
This is pitched up, on off, Shan Masood knocks it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length, down the leg. Iftikhar Ahmed flicks it to fine leg for an easy boundary.
Full and on the off stump. Ahmed taps it on the offside and decides against running through for a quick single.
Short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed drives it off the back foot towards cover for a couple.
Full, on off. Iftikhar Ahmed blocks it off the front foot towards the bowler.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Two wickets in a span of three deliveries. Reece Topley strikes in his first over and gets the wicket of in-form Rizwan. He bowls this much fuller and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan is expecting the inswing and goes for the flick, but the ball just straightens after hitting the deck and Rizwan closes the face of his bat early. The ball goes through and shatters the stumps. Pakistan lose both their openers and are in a spot of bother.
Short, onto the pads. Mohammad Rizwan looks to flick that but gets hit on his pads.
Shan Masood is in at number 3. Also, it will be Reece Topley to start from the other end.

OUT! TAKEN! Chris Woakes draws first blood and sends the opposition skipper back to the hut. He bowls this full and around off, slower too, Babar Azam looks to drive it but is early through his shot and ends up just lobbing it straight into the hands of Harry Brook stationed at short cover. Pakistan lose their first wicket and Babar Azam's night ends in dismay.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Brook b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on off, Babar Azam drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Babar Azam gets off the mark in style! Chris Woakes serves this fuller and on off, Babar Azam just clips it away through wide mid on for a boundary.
On a length again and on off, Babar Azam stays back and blocks it on to the ground.
Pakistan are underway! This is back of a length and on off, Mohammad Rizwan taps it to the off side for a quick single.
Chris Woakes starts with a yorker-length delivery, on middle, Mohammad Rizwan digs it out towards mid-wicket.
